usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is empty; only identity anchors (name, birth details, IMF MD role, prior EU Commissioner and World Bank chief executive roles) and one retained Wikipedia source exist. A reader learns only the barest identity — who she is by title — but nothing about what she actually did, her career trajectory, policies, or controversies. No statements exist in the dossier to assess for overclaims, so the two listed unjustified conclusions (crisis-outcomes, world-bank-president) cannot be matched to any cited dossier text. The dossier nowhere states what it does not know, and there is insufficient material to prepare for a meeting.
